items.statement: Standalone net sales increased by 16.7% supported by healthy volume growth and pricing measures.
items.quote: Net Sales growth of 16.7% led by healthy volume growth and aided by pricing actions

items.statement: International business profitability improved due to cost controls, led by gains in Asia and the Middle East.
items.quote: Improvement in profitability through cost optimization and control; Profit growth led by Asia and Middle East PBT margin at 7.9%, higher by 275 bps yoy

items.statement: Bath segment revenue declined by 4.3% while PBT losses expanded to ₹9 crore.
items.quote: Revenue for the quarter came in at ₹85 cr, lower by 4.3% PBT losses increased to ₹9 cr compared to ₹2 cr loss in Q1FY26

items.statement: PPGAP industrial business PBT margin fell by 114 basis points year-over-year to 6.9%.
items.quote: PBT margin at 6.9% for the quarter; lower by 114 bps yoy

items.statement: Near-term operating conditions remain uncertain due to heightened raw material and logistics volatility from renewed conflict.
items.quote: The renewed conflict has intensified volatility across raw material costs and supply chain logistics, keeping the near-term operating environment uncertain

items.statement: The company plans to step up investments in innovation and brand building to enhance differentiation and consumer relevance.
items.quote: Step up investment in innovation and brand-building to deepen consumer relevance, sharpen differentiation and strengthen market salience

items.statement: Demand grew across both rural and urban markets, with rural areas expanding faster than urban centres.
items.quote: Growth witnessed across rural and urban markets, with rural markets continuing to grow ahead of urban

items.statement: Coatings solutions and services saw strong demand driven by growth in the buildings, factories, and government segments.
items.quote: Strong growth in Buildings, Factories and Government segments driving synergy across Coatings solutions and services

items.statement: The company utilized calibrated price adjustments and lower-cost inventory to counter steep raw material inflation.
items.quote: Lower cost inventory & calibrated pricing interventions absorbed the impact of steep inflation. Also supported by better mix and continued efforts on driving sourcing and formulation efficiencies

items.statement: Management aims to drive operational efficiencies to absorb cost pressures, defend profit margins, and protect demand.
items.quote: Drive cost efficiencies to absorb external pressures, protect margins and safeguard demand momentum

items.statement: The upcoming commissioning of the first phase of the VAM-VAE facility is expected to enhance the launch of differentiated products.
items.quote: The planned commissioning of the first phase of VAM-VAE expected to meaningfully strengthen our ability to develop and launch differentiated product propositions

items.statement: Newly introduced products contributed roughly 17% of total revenue during the quarter.
items.quote: Innovation-led propositions continued to gain traction; new products contributing ~17% of overall revenues

items.statement: The company launched WoodTech Emporio Orano, an ultra-luxury Italian PU finish designed in Italy for India.
items.quote: Ultra luxury Italian PU finish Designed and made in Italy for India Best in class grain filling and film clarity Excellent Durability

items.statement: Identified business risks include economic conditions, foreign exchange and commodity volatility, competitive pressures, and regulatory changes.
items.quote: Potential risks and uncertainties include such factors as general economic conditions, foreign exchange and commodity price fluctuations, competitive product and pricing pressures and regulatory developments.

items.statement: neutral
items.quote: The renewed conflict has intensified volatility across raw material costs and supply chain logistics, keeping the near-term operating environment uncertain

items.statement: The decorative paint business achieved value growth of 16.6% in the first quarter.
items.quote: If you look at the value, the decorative value has grown at a very good pitch of about 16.6%, albeit on a lower base.

items.statement: International business grew by approximately 27% during the quarter with broad-based regional performance.
items.quote: This has yielded results. We have grown at about 27% in Q1. This has been a very strong performance. The performance has been broad-based across regions.

items.statement: Automotive OE business PBT margin declined by 119 basis points to 15.7%.
items.quote: The PBT margins have been a little bit stressed here, about 15.7%, lower by 119 bps.

items.statement: Operations in Ethiopia faced difficulties resulting from currency devaluation.
items.quote: If you look at various countries, every country performed well, except in Africa, where Ethiopia faced currency devaluation-related challenges.

items.statement: Management expects full-year FY27 volume growth to remain between 8% and 10%.
items.quote: At the current stage, we are looking at the band of 8-10% for the full FY27.

items.statement: Asian Paints reiterated its PBDIT margin guidance band of 18% to 20%.
items.quote: We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds.

items.statement: The company intends to focus on agility, speed, and discipline in the second quarter to sustain growth momentum.
items.quote: When we look at Q2, agility is very important. We look at speed and discipline coming so that we can sustain this growth momentum of what we are taking.

items.statement: Management expects the industrial segment to maintain faster growth than the decorative segment going forward.
items.quote: Overall, my belief is that industrial will continue to grow at a higher pitch than decorative as we look ahead.

items.statement: Volume growth in rural markets was significantly stronger than in urban markets during the quarter.
items.quote: Overall, we are seeing good volume growth. We have seen that growth in rural markets has been much better compared to urban markets.

items.statement: Demand conditions remained steady across all three months of the quarter.
items.quote: The demand conditions have been decent of what we have seen. As I said, all three months, the demand has been decent.

items.statement: Decorative value growth was supported by a weighted average price hike of approximately 6.8%.
items.quote: Overall, it has grown at a very good pitch overall, to some extent aided by some of the price increases as well, possibly a weighted price increase of about 6.8% or so of what is captured in it.

items.statement: The company implemented weighted average price increases of around 7%, varying across product categories.
items.quote: The weighted average price increase has been about 7%. Overall, it depends on the product mix because there is a differential pricing which has happened on each category in terms of what we have taken.

items.statement: Raw material cost inflation reached approximately 25% despite price increases of around 7%.
items.quote: While we took price increases in April, May and June, the overall weighted average price increase was around 7%. The material inflation was still very high to the extent of about 25%.

items.statement: Key raw material prices continue to fluctuate, with titanium dioxide prices beginning to climb.
items.quote: We'll have to live with this fluctuation, which has started that some of the prices, for example, we have seen that the TiO2 prices were fairly stable, but it has started going up.

items.statement: Gross margin faced pressure at 45.6% during the quarter but improved on a year-on-year basis.
items.quote: There was some pressure on gross margin; we were at about 45.6% in the last quarter. However, we are still higher if you look at it on a YoY basis.

items.statement: Second-quarter margins are historically lower due to the seasonal product mix.
items.quote: What we have seen is that quarter two has traditionally been a lower margin because of the mix of what we sell in quarter two overall.

items.statement: The white cement plant in Fujairah, UAE, is fully operational and running at strong capacity levels.
items.quote: We have already completed our white cement plant, which is now fully operational and running at very good capacities in Fujairah, UAE.

items.statement: Asian Paints anticipates reaching near 150,000 MT capacity in VAE over the next two to two-and-a-half years.
items.quote: Our feeling is that possibly over a period of about 2-2.5 years, we should be able to reach basically a capacity which is higher and closer to about 150,000 MT.

items.statement: Asian Paints is setting up an advanced VAM-VAE manufacturing ecosystem in India.
items.quote: The second state-of-the-art initiative that is coming up is what we call the VAM-VAE manufacturing ecosystem. This is the first time that someone in India has invoked this technology.

items.statement: Newly introduced products account for 17% of total company revenues.
items.quote: If you look at the overall picture, our innovation-led approach has delivered strong results. New products within the portfolio contribute 17% of our overall revenues.

items.statement: Competitive intensity across the paint industry is currently at peak levels.
items.quote: The competitive intensity seems to be at an all-time high. I don't think there is any leeway there.

items.statement: Competitive intensity is elevated across all segments, including economy, premium, and luxury.
items.quote: As far as the economy products are concerned, today, the competition intensity is across, whether it is economy, whether it is premium and whether it is in luxury.

items.statement: Raw material price volatility and supply chain disruptions driven by crude dependency represent key operational risks.
items.quote: The volatility in raw material prices continues, and it puts pressure on supply chain logistics, both from freight availability and price fluctuations across key inputs, given the fact that the paint industry is largely dependent on crude and crude derivatives.

items.statement: positive
items.quote: Today, the demand conditions, as we look at quarter two, we are entering a festive quarter where the month of September becomes good enough from some festive sales.
